verdict.rationale: Belvo documents an Institutions Status page that users can subscribe to for automatic outage notifications, and an API errors reference keyed by error code with causes and solutions. That covers outage signals and error-code documentation. However, nothing shows per-institution status fields, degradation versus outage granularity, or error codes that explicitly separate institution-side failures from client-side ones. Missing for 10: documented per-institution status values in the API, degradation signals beyond outages, error-code taxonomy distinguishing bank problems from integration problems, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem

citations.quote: subscribe to our Institutions Status page so you are automatically notified of any outages.
